title: Global Leaders Gather for UN Climate Summit Amidst Renewed Urgency
title_hi: जलवायु परिवर्तन पर संयुक्त राष्ट्र शिखर सम्मेलन में दुनिया भर के नेता, नई तात्कालिकता के बीच इकट्ठा हुए
details: The United Nations Climate Change Conference (COP29) has commenced in Baku, Azerbaijan, with heads of state and climate negotiators from around the world convening to discuss urgent actions to combat global warming. Key agenda items include setting new emissions reduction targets, mobilizing climate finance for developing nations, and addressing the escalating impacts of extreme weather events.
hook: क्या दुनिया जलवायु परिवर्तन को रोकने के लिए एकजुट हो पाएगी?
